sources.label: Nature Physics, August 24, 2026 — Decaying and expanding Erk gradients process memory of skeletal size during zebrafish fin regeneration

research.summary: A dark fold, a lifted edge, and a shape left open. Inspired by research on zebrafish fin regeneration, in which Erk signalling gradients scale with missing tissue and help explain how regenerating structures recover their size.

title: The Shape Left Open · 未合的形
